note: A log.declaration-key entry with no jwk at 2 is no key and holds no position, so the real declaration key at 3 is the first published, and the declaration at 5 it signs is honoured. Statements are the exact output of CanonicalizeWithNfc, each signature is detached under its kind's header typ with its role's member as the header kid (spec 4.5); the keys the case publishes are its own log.key and log.declaration-key entries. expected.json is written from this construction and never by running a verifier. A proposal: it may be regenerated until the owner's lift record pins its digests.
